sources.title: Neighbourhood health centres
sources.verified_claim: NHS England published planning guidance, an activity calculator and accommodation tools for neighbourhood health centres. These support capacity planning for proposed schemes but do not establish primary-care capacity at any sample parcel.

sources.title: Neighbourhood health centre guidance for regions and integrated care boards
sources.verified_claim: The guidance instructs regions and ICBs on identifying neighbourhood-health estate proposals, pipeline development and funding. Scheme planning or funding routes are not parcel-specific healthcare-capacity evidence.

sources.title: Neighbourhood health centres
sources.verified_claim: NHS England states systems should maximise existing estate first and provides tools for utilisation, clinical-space and layout planning. This is a planning framework, not evidence that a sample parcel can support or access a centre.

sources.title: Londoners to benefit as six neighbourhood health centres are upgraded to bring more care closer to home
sources.verified_claim: NHS England London identifies six named London health-centre upgrades backed by national investment, with completion expected by 2027. Those named projects are not evidence of delivery or spare capacity at the three sample parcels.

sources.title: A public deliberation on the future of primary care in London
sources.verified_claim: NHS England London states around 52 million primary-care appointments occur annually in London and describes demand, resource and fragmentation pressures. London-wide pressure is not a measure of service capacity for a sample parcel.

sources.title: A Neighbourhood Health Service for London: The Targeted Operating Model
sources.verified_claim: The London operating model commits partners to neighbourhood-level integration across primary, community, mental-health and wider public services. Operating-model intent does not prove local estate headroom or delivery at a parcel.

sources.title: Introduction to the Targeted Operating Model
sources.verified_claim: NHS England London explicitly identifies workforce, estates and demand challenges and notes a greater than 20% reduction in London GP practices over the prior decade. Regional pressure is not an exact local-capacity result.

sources.title: Changes to the GP Contract in 2026/27
sources.verified_claim: The 2026/27 GP contract changes include a practice-level GP reimbursement scheme and revised PCN recruitment rules intended to support access. Funding or recruitment policy does not guarantee workforce availability at a specific neighbourhood or parcel.
